preregistration.operator: User-authorized; main-agent review required before dispatch

study.research_question: Does the matched final-verdict engine close actual rejection, consumed feedback, repair and independent task verification under two fixed candidate interventions?
study.research_gap: Prior natural trials had no negative judgments; same-snapshot probes had no root continuation.
study.hypothesis: Both engines may close repair, while judgment and downstream repair burden can differ.

primary_metric.name: closed_repair_delta
primary_metric.aggregation: (Jev closed repairs minus LLM closed repairs) / 2 paired conditions

study.decision_rule: Diagnostic only. Two fresh no-injection admission arms must be valid and pass with reviewed playback before four controlled cells. No adoption, release or publication authority.
study.invalidation_rule: Stop on incomplete exports, observation/checker/source/usage/credential failure or timeout. Preserve invalid trials as unknown; any missing/invalid planned cell makes primary not measurable. Valid semantic failures continue.
study.analysis_plan: One authored single-status task family with two dependent conditions, two engines and one repetition. Report closed repair by condition and arm, native first-verdict discrimination, false acceptance, hold, root/cognitive/judge/replan/tool burden, tokens and separate tariffs. No pooling with admission, old natural trials or snapshots. Preselected replay: recovery-contradiction, repetition0, including failure.

environment.reset_strategy: Fresh public-network agent and separate static no-network verifier containers per cell; native Harbor artifact transfer only. No operator workspace mounted. Provider-free actual infrastructure proof expires after 24h. Root 180s, Harbor agent 210s, host watchdog 930s plus cancellation cleanup up to 120s. No trial rerun or helper HTTP retry; identical bounded root retry policy inherited.

comparison.comparator: A: subscription Astra/xhigh typed final verdict; B: direct jev-1.13.0 verdict. Same root/cognitive/feedback policy and controlled candidate replacement; runtime arm=a0.

privacy.redaction_boundary: All trial prompts, provider receipts, databases, IDs and host paths are withheld-private pending exact-byte review. Never persist key contents in configs or metadata; actual charges stay unknown.
